_comment: Copy this to email_config.json (gitignored). Two delivery methods:
_option_A_gmail_api: RECOMMENDED when App Passwords are disabled. Sends via the Gmail API using the SAME Google login already used for Sheets (no password). Requires: (1) gmail.send scope (already in SCOPES) so you re-approve consent once, (2) the Gmail API enabled in your OAuth project. Config is just method/to/sender:
_option_B_smtp: Classic SMTP with a Gmail App Password (needs 2-Step Verification + App Passwords enabled by your admin). Use these keys INSTEAD of method=gmail_api:
